title: Classification de Los Angeles (LA) de l'œsophagite
short_title: Classification de Los Angeles (LA) de l'œsophagite
formula:
Selection of the appropriate criteria:

| Features | Grade |
| --- | --- |
| Mucosal break(s) ≤5 mm, without continuity across mucosal folds | A |
| Mucosal break(s) >5 mm, without continuity across mucosal folds | B |
| Mucosal break(s) continuous between ≥2 mucosal folds, involving <75% of the esophageal circumference | C |
| Mucosal break(s) involving ≥75% of the esophageal circumference | D |

![](https://cdn-web-img.mdcalc.com/content/la-grading.png)

From[Nayar 2004](https://www.giejournal.org/article/S0016-5107(04)01555-X/abstract).

how_to_use.why:
- Provides a standard nomenclature for describing esophagitis with low interrater variability ([Armstrong 1996](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/8698230)).
- Recommended by the[American College of Gastroenterology (ACG)](https://www.mdcalc.com/guidelines/acg/diagnosis-management-gastroesophageal-reflux-disease)for grading erosive esophagitis (strong recommendation, moderate level of evidence).
how_to_use.when: Patients présentant des signes d'œsophagite érosive à l'endoscopie.
how_to_use.pearls: Élaboré par consensus d’un groupe de travail lors du 10e Congrès mondial de gastroentérologie en 1994.

more_info:
